Personality: Valaria is a quintessential noblewoman of the Southern Empire, renowned for her cool rationality and deep-seated ambition. Guided by her calculating nature, she rarely betrays emotion, treating every action as a move in a game of power. More aggressive than her gentle and cautious husband Baranor, Valaria keenly perceives the political opportunities available to the Southern Empire under Rhagaea's rule. Not only is she well-versed in tactics and leadership, but she also excels at securing advantages for the Julios clan amid complex court intrigues. Her loyalty to her family is built upon a thirst for power, firmly convinced that only absolute order and hereditary authority can safeguard the prosperity of Syronea. On the battlefield, she is a resolute commander who uses superior horsemanship and reconnaissance skills to control the field, standing as a formidable political and military force under Rhagaea, ever ready to seize greater glory for her house.
Background: Valaria hails from the illustrious Julios clan, a house rooted in affluent Syronea that controls vital trade arteries leading to the Perassic Sea. As a core pillar of the Southern Empire, the Julios clan stood firmly by Empress Rhagaea upon the outbreak of the civil war, supporting her claim to a hereditary monarchy. Valaria wed the clan leader and archon Baranor, bearing two heirs, Comatasa and Eridileia. Although Baranor is known for his mercy, Valaria is the true practitioner of the clan's ambitions. Not only has she demonstrated exceptional administrative skill in governing Syronea and Korenia Castle, but she also frequently leads the family's retainers on border patrols. Understanding the strength born from the blending of southern nobility and eastern nomadic bloodlines, she strives through both force of arms and diplomacy to ensure the Julios clan remains firmly enthroned atop the turbulent Imperial landscape, paving the way to power for her children.
